clauses.text:
2657
)1xecutive order.
Edward A. Savoy may be promoted from the position of Chief Mes-
senger to a clerkship in the classified executive civil service of the State
Department without reference to the requirements of the Civil Service
Rules.
This order is issued on the recommendation of the Secretary of State,
because of the long and faithful service of Edward Savoy, wvho was ap-
pointed a Page in the State Department in 1869, and has since been pro-
moted to be assistant messenger, messenger and chief messenger in the
Department.
